_comment: Issue #81 'Renn's Old Warhammer' (data/quests.json, renns_warhammer): Renn's REAL conversation graph, replacing the old repeated-forever dialogue[0] fallback (skeleton_scene.json's own comment on renn flagged him 'inert-adjacent by design' -- this is that v2). POSTING-SEEDED: the 'ask' option is hidden until guild_board's rumor_lost_hammer has been read (heard_about_lost_hammer). Two real beats, BOTH same-map as the giver (guild): 'search' (renns_gear_stash's on_open_accomplishment) and 'report' (the item-gated turn-in option here, requires:{item:renns_warhammer} -- the sixth sanctioned single-key gate, non-progress-gated so it stays visible/greyed rather than hidden, same as patron_serving's Serve option). Always-available exit: 'Just passing through.' carries neither requires nor hide_when.

hub.speaker: Renn
hub.text: Still four silver. Still an insult.

text_variants.text: Still looking? It's a warhammer, not a needle. Back wall, I said.
Got my hammer back and I'm still complaining about the board. Some things don't change.

options.text: I hear you're missing a warhammer.
Found this by the back wall. Yours?

explain.speaker: Renn
explain.text: Backup hammer. Left it propped against the back wall last time I hauled kit through here, and it's not there now, and Ilvo will not stop laughing about it.

thanks.speaker: Renn
thanks.text: It WAS the back wall. I told him. Three gold, and don't tell Ilvo I paid for this — actually, tell him. It'll shut him up faster than the gold will.
